schedule.description: Final game: Cubs-Red Sox at Tropicana Field, 2:05 PM CT
WCS Bold Take: Cubs 5-1 vs. Padres, not scared of Petco
Brewers looming: NLDS stakes if Cubs advance
Pre-game kicker: last regular season game, real thing Tuesday

stories.title: Final Regular Season Game — Neutral Site at Tropicana Field
stories.angle: Cubs-Red Sox finale relocated to Tropicana Field due to nor'easter — one of ~6 neutral-site relocations in MLB history. First pitch 2:05 PM CT. Probables TBD. Cubs locked as WC2 — result is seeding-only. WCS looms Tuesday at Petco.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Cubs vs. Red Sox at neutral Tropicana Field. 2:05 PM CT.

A nor'easter forced the move from Fenway — one of ~6 neutral-site game relocations in MLB history.

Seeding's locked. WC2 is ours. This one's a warmup before Tuesday at Petco.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: WCS Bold Take — Cubs Have Padres' Number
stories.angle: Cubs went 5-1 vs. Padres in 2026. Swept a 3-game set at Wrigley (June 29–July 1). Won the 2025 WCS rematch at Wrigley. San Diego has home-field. Cubs have the receipts.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
5-1 vs. the Padres this year. A 23-3 blowout. A sweep at Wrigley.

Won the WCS rematch last October.

San Diego thinks home-field is an advantage. We've seen their rotation. We're not scared.

#Cubs #FlyTheW #GoCubs

stories.title: PCA 45/40 Season — Stat Breakdown, MVP Lock
stories.angle: .280 / 45 HR / 40 SB — 7th in 40-40 history, first Cub ever, only 3rd player with 45+ HR + 40+ SB (Ohtani and Soriano). 10.6 fWAR — best Cubs season since Rogers Hornsby 1929. NL MVP is a formality.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong's 2026 final line: .280, 45 HR, 40 SB.

7th in 40-40 history. Only Ohtani and Soriano ever hit 45+ HR AND stole 40+ bases.

10.6 fWAR — best Cubs season since Rogers Hornsby in 1929. He's 24.

NL MVP vote is a formality.

#Cubs #GoCubs #CubsBaseball

stories.title: Gausman + Steele — WCS Roster Puzzle
stories.angle: Two open questions before WCS Game 1 Tuesday: Gausman's left shoulder (day-to-day, Counsell: "We go day by day"); Steele not activated this weekend but WCS roster is still open. Rest of October lineup: healthy, locked.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Two questions before WCS Game 1 on Tuesday:

Gausman's shoulder — day-to-day, could still start. "We go day by day" — Counsell.

Steele — not activated this weekend, but WCS roster still open.

The rest of the lineup? Healthy. Locked. Let's go.

#Cubs #MLB #CubsBaseball

stories.title: Brewers Looming — NLDS Stakes If Cubs Advance
stories.angle: If Cubs get past the Padres, the Brewers (97 wins, NL No. 1 seed, 4th straight NL Central title, went 9-4 vs Cubs in 2026) are waiting in the NLDS. Set the stakes. Rival jab energy.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
If the Cubs get past the Padres, the reward is the Brewers.

97 wins. NL's No. 1 seed. 4th straight division title. Went 9-4 against us in 2026.

But they also spent September watching PCA make history.

Milwaukee's waiting. We're not afraid of Milwaukee.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Pre-Game Kicker — Last One Before October
stories.angle: Cubs play their final regular season game in 50 minutes. 88-73. Wild Card No. 2. MVP in center field. Warmup starts now. Real thing is Tuesday in San Diego.

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
In 50 minutes, the Cubs play their last regular season game of 2026.

88-73. Wild Card No. 2. A franchise-best offense. An MVP in center field.

The warmup's about to start. The real thing is Tuesday in San Diego.

#Cubs #FlyTheW #GoCubs
